div.div: 4 اطفحهُ ; (S, A, K;) and ↓ طفّحهُ , (S, K,) inf. n. تَطْفِيحٌ; (S;) and ↓ طَفَحَهُ , (K,) inf. n. طَفْحٌ; (TA;) He filled it so that it overflowed: (S, A:) or he filled it so that it became high [in its contents]: (K:) namely, a vessel, (S, A, K,) and a river, or rivulet, and a watering-trough, or tank. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
